div.head: Af El. 49.8
div.ab: Hy ða on monigum synoþum monegra menniscra misdæda bote gesetton, ond on monegra synoþbec hy writon, hwær ænne dóm hwær oþerne.
Hie ða on monegum senoðum monegra menniscra misdæda bote gesetton, ⁊ on monega senoðbéc hie writan, hwær anne dom hwær oþerne.
Et in multis synodis suis multorum forisfactorum emendationes aptauerunt et ex multis synodalibus libris undecumque capitula conscripserunt.
Hie ða on monegum senoðum monegra menniscra misdæda bote gesetton, ⁊ on monega senoðbéc hie writan, hwær anne dom hwær oþerne.
Then they established in many synods the remedies for the various misdeeds of men, and they wrote in many books of synodal decrees, in one place one judgment and in one place another.
They then in many synods fixed the compensations for many human misdeeds, and they wrote them in many synod-books, here one law, there another.
Sie setzten da auf vielen Synoden die Busse fest für viele menschliche Missethaten und schrieben sie in viele Synodenbücher, hier ein Gesetz, dort ein anderes.
They then established at many synods the compensation for many human misdeeds and wrote them into many synod-books, here one law, there another.
